singleCellFvMesh Class Reference

fvMesh as subset of other mesh. Consists of one cell and all original boundary faces. Useful when manipulating boundary data. Single internal cell only needed to be able to manipulate in a standard way. More...

Detailed Description

fvMesh as subset of other mesh. Consists of one cell and all original boundary faces. Useful when manipulating boundary data. Single internal cell only needed to be able to manipulate in a standard way.
